t2i_prompt: A 1440 px wide desktop website section as a flat straight-on UI mockup on a pale limestone background. A small mono eyebrow and a large light-weight navy sans headline in sentence case at top-left. Left column: four numbered steps, each a mono number, a mono title and a short note for <CONTENT>, with key figures in steel blue. Right: an isometric technical line drawing of white modular polypropylene equipment arranged in a ring and joined by short pipes, uniform navy strokes, white fills, no shading or hatching, with a few hairline leader labels. Calm, precise.
signature_idea: Steps run down a mono column beside a ring of isometric line-drawn PP modules, like a catalogue spread.
strengths: clean isometric catalogue drawing fits the brand's line-art direction
steel-blue inline figures are a disciplined single accent
light headline and lots of space
step list is simple and buildable
weaknesses: drawing labels are redundant and garbled (polypropylene modular equipment twice)
steps and drawing do not connect; modules are not numbered to steps
mono for whole step bodies is dense and less readable
strokes are heavier than hairline, blocky toy-like modules
brand_fit_why: Light headline, mono figures, one steel-blue accent and isometric line art fit; generic labels and the unlinked drawing cost a point.
